text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, when I stopped by the shopping 
mall...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hey, Tazuna-saaan. Pretty please~?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I appreciate the invite, but...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer-kun! Perfect timing!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer-chan! Just in time!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Please! Help me convince Tazuna-san~!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yep, yep! Ran into her by chance earlier, 
and looks like she just finished running 
an errand for the Chairwoman.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
So, how about we hang out a bit to take a 
breather! ...is what I'm trying to invite 
you to do, but...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"The Chairwoman is waiting as well, so we 
must head back quickly."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, she's been like this the whole time~! 
Such a little goody two-shoes~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Maruzensky and Tazuna-san get 
along quite well, despite their 
relationship being that of a student and 
the Chairwoman's secretary.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I heard you've been working non-stop 
lately. Everyone's worried about you, you 
know~.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: However...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Go on, just shoot 'em a quick message on 
that groovy smartphone of yours♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"I'll just tell them, ‘I'm heading to a 
kissaten with Maruzensky-san for some 
lem-squash’☆"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Lemon squash at a coffee shop... It does 
sound lovely, but...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey, you think it's fine to go play 
too, right, Trainer-kun?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey, you think it's fine to go play 
too, right, Trainer-chan?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I understand Maruzensky's pushy yet kind 
consideration, as well as Tazuna-san's 
seriousness. So right here...
choice_data_list:
We could also take our time heading back 
to the academy.
I think it's fine to have a little fun.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's an unexpected answer. Care to 
elaborate?
choice_data_list: How about chatting to refresh yourself?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Well, true enough... Chatting with 
friends really does have a refreshing 
effect, doesn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
See, Trainer-san says so too! Let's head 
back together.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, look at that face, acting like 
you've been saved~. Boo-boo.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... I understand how you feel, 
Maruzen-san. Thank you so much.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh please, it's nothing like that. 
Just chatting is kind of boring, 
though..."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I should let Trainer-kun in on one 
of Ms. Tazuna's top-secret secrets♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Maybe I'll let Trainer-chan in on a super 
special secret about Tazuna-san♪"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: What?! Wh-What is that...!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"The other day, when I dropped by her room 
unannounced and opened the creaking 
closet—"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Maruzensky-san!!!!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, just kidding! Well then, shall we 
head back?♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the end, nothing was said about the 
secret, but it turned into a peaceful walk 
home that showed just how close the two of 
them were.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
See~! I knew you'd agree with me, 
Trainer-kun!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
See~! I knew you'd agree with me, 
Trainer-chan!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Now that it's come to this, wouldn't it be 
better to just brace yourself and play 
along with me?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"...Fine, I understand. Just for ten 
minutes, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Yay, got Tazuna-san☆

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
By the way, Trainer-kun, your 
participation is mandatory!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
By the way, Trainer-chan, your 
participation is mandatory!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, so you'd already read how it'd play 
out! As expected of my Trainer-kun☆

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, so you'd already read how it'd play 
out! As expected of my Trainer-chan☆

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let's start with some shopping! 
Off we go on a shopping spree☆

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Ah, please wait!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Honestly, you really are a 
meddler.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, the three of us browsed the 
shopping mall. We were completely worn 
out, but it was a great way to unwind.
